title: DkimSigner type spelled out 3x — missing type alias
description: Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner<mail_auth::common::crypto::Ed25519Key, mail_auth::dkim::Done>> appears 3 times verbatim (struct field, constructor parameter, test helper return type). A type alias 'type Ed25519DkimSigner = mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner<mail_auth::common::crypto::Ed25519Key, mail_auth::dkim::Done>;' would make all three sites readable and prevent a typo mismatch between them. This also makes it clear the type is a complete, finalized signer (Done state) vs. a builder.
